== Summary ==
Players Committee cutout slip for [[Endor: Ewok Village (V) (Errata 4)]], from [[:File:PC-Errata-December-2022.pdf|Errata Sheet December 2022]], page 5, image xref65/mask64. The actual face prints E1; its article ordinal is Errata 4. The source filename records PDF build metadata 19 December 2022; the cover/footer establish only the December 2022 edition, not an exact publication day. The same JPEG bytes and mask stream appear in [[:File:Virtual-Set-8-June-2023.pdf|Set 8, June 2023]], page 7, image xref122/mask121. This repeat is one image state. Existing Wiki PNG bytes are unchanged. Its white-background display differs from the source’s white composition by at most 1 RGB unit on 109 pixels, consistent with conversion rounding; no art is reconstructed. Lucasfilm Ltd.; published by the Players Committee.
